elements.text:
Your crush hasn't responded in a few days. After long deliberation, you send a double text. 

Here are some behaviors that someone might do at that moment or in the future:

texts: I send a third text immediately trying to walk back the second one.
I feel tempted to screenshot the conversation and send to another friend to ask for help, but manage to control the urge.
I put my phone down and go do something else after sending the text.
I want to check my phone every few minutes, but set it aside and give it real time.
I text another friend to distract myself.
